correctness.rationale: The direction-dependent intersection volumes have a complete exact derivation: k=1 homothety; k=2 transformed-square slicing with beta-integral; k=3 explicit three-interval planar-lens integration and higher-dimensional shell integration. The separately run checker verified the three-dimensional lens integral, general symbolic identities in dimensions 3..12, 18 independently reconstructed 3D intersection volumes and exact root ordering. Finite checks corroborate, and do not establish, all-dimensional claims.

value.rationale: The regular octahedron and its higher-dimensional crosspolytopes are natural convex bodies whose directional covariograms encode chord distributions and anisotropy. The full exact 1–3-sparse displacement family, plus two algebraic order reversals among *all three* three-dimensional symmetry-axis classes, is a structurally motivated invariant not reducible to a scalar mean or an arbitrary numerical slice.
